cases.name: unchanged-with-any-palette-mode
cases.condition: change is UNCHANGED; desaturate(color) is returned, and diffRoles is not read whether it is defined or undefined.
cases.outcome: For UNCHANGED, return desaturate(color) without reading diffRoles, whether it is defined or undefined.
cases.domain: any color string and either presence or absence of diffRoles

cases.name: unspecified-with-any-palette-mode
cases.condition: change is CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED; desaturate(color) is returned, and diffRoles is not read whether it is defined or undefined.
cases.outcome: For CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, return desaturate(color) without reading diffRoles, whether it is defined or undefined.
cases.domain: any color string and either presence or absence of diffRoles

cases.name: added-table-mode
cases.condition: change is ADDED and diffRoles is defined; diffRoles.added is returned as-is, while color is discarded.
cases.outcome: For ADDED with defined diffRoles, return diffRoles.added as-is and discard color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles

cases.name: modified-table-mode
cases.condition: change is MODIFIED and diffRoles is defined; diffRoles.modified is returned as-is, while color is discarded.
cases.outcome: For MODIFIED with defined diffRoles, return diffRoles.modified as-is and discard color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles

cases.name: deleted-table-mode
cases.condition: change is DELETED and diffRoles is defined; diffRoles.deleted is returned as-is, while color is discarded.
cases.outcome: For DELETED with defined diffRoles, return diffRoles.deleted as-is and discard color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles

cases.name: added-rotate-mode
cases.condition: change is ADDED and diffRoles is undefined; rotateHue(color, 300) is returned.
cases.outcome: For ADDED with undefined diffRoles, return rotateHue(color, 300).
cases.domain: any color string

cases.name: modified-rotate-mode
cases.condition: change is MODIFIED and diffRoles is undefined; rotateHue(color, 60) is returned.
cases.outcome: For MODIFIED with undefined diffRoles, return rotateHue(color, 60).
cases.domain: any color string

cases.name: deleted-rotate-mode
cases.condition: change is DELETED and diffRoles is undefined; rotateHue(color, 180) is returned.
cases.outcome: For DELETED with undefined diffRoles, return rotateHue(color, 180).
cases.domain: any color string

cases.name: saturated-rotate-separation
cases.condition: In rotate mode, color has saturation greater than zero; the ADDED, MODIFIED, and DELETED angles produce three different hues and therefore three different strings.
cases.outcome: In rotate mode with a color whose saturation is greater than zero, produce three different strings for ADDED, MODIFIED, and DELETED.
cases.domain: any color with saturation greater than zero

cases.name: desaturated-rotate-identity
cases.condition: In rotate mode, color is fully desaturated; rotation is the identity, so ADDED, MODIFIED, and DELETED return the same string, with only DELETED distinguished by ghosting elsewhere.
cases.outcome: In rotate mode with a fully desaturated color, return the same string for all three changes, with only DELETED distinguished by ghosting elsewhere.
cases.domain: any fully desaturated color

cases.name: non-hex-color-transform-path
cases.condition: color is not a hex string; there is no validation or rejection, and it reaches desaturate or rotateHue in the non-table branches, which return it unchanged.
cases.outcome: For a non-hex color, perform no validation or rejection and pass it through desaturate or rotateHue unchanged outside table mode.
cases.domain: any non-hex color string

cases.name: empty-diagram
cases.condition: laidOut contains no nodes, edges, groups, or annotations; the function returns a diagram with the canvas carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with no elements and the canvas carried through unchanged.

cases.name: nodes-with-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out node has an id present in overlay.nodes; its shape and typography are replaced using that entry's change type, while all non-styling fields are preserved.
cases.outcome: Recolours the node's shape and typography using its overlay change type while preserving every non-styling field.
cases.domain: one or more nodes

cases.name: node-without-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out node's id is absent from overlay.nodes; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing and is recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the node as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its shape and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any node id absent from overlay.nodes

cases.name: groups-with-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out group has an id present in overlay.groups; its shape and typography are replaced using that entry's change type, while all non-styling fields are preserved.
cases.outcome: Recolours the group's shape and typography using its overlay change type while preserving every non-styling field.
cases.domain: one or more groups

cases.name: group-without-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out group's id is absent from overlay.groups; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing and is recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the group as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its shape and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any group id absent from overlay.groups

cases.name: edges-with-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out edge has an id present in overlay.edges; its connection and typography are replaced using that entry's change type, while sections and all other non-styling fields are preserved.
cases.outcome: Recolours the edge's connection and typography using its overlay change type while preserving sections and every other non-styling field.
cases.domain: one or more edges

cases.name: edge-without-overlay-entry
cases.condition: A laid-out edge's id is absent from overlay.edges; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing and is recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the edge as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its connection and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any edge id absent from overlay.edges

cases.name: annotations-with-callout
cases.condition: A laid-out annotation has a callout; it is always treated as UNCHANGED without any overlay lookup, its shape and typography are recoloured, and its callout is recoloured as a line.
cases.outcome: Treats the annotation as UNCHANGED without an overlay lookup, recolours its shape, typography, and set callout, and preserves all other fields.
cases.domain: one or more annotations with a set callout

cases.name: annotations-without-callout
cases.condition: A laid-out annotation has no callout; it is always treated as UNCHANGED without any overlay lookup, its shape and typography are recoloured, and the callout remains unset.
cases.outcome: Treats the annotation as UNCHANGED without an overlay lookup, recolours its shape and typography, and leaves the callout unset.
cases.domain: one or more annotations with an unset callout

cases.name: mixed-element-kinds
cases.condition: The diagram contains any combination of nodes, edges, groups, and annotations; each element uses its kind's styling recolour operations and the appropriate overlay map, except annotations which never perform a map lookup.
cases.outcome: Recolours each element with its kind-specific operations and map, while annotations are recoloured as UNCHANGED without a map lookup.
cases.domain: any mixture of the four element kinds

cases.name: single-role-resolution
cases.condition: The diagram contains one or more elements; resolveDiffRoles(tokens) is called once before walking them, and the same result is passed to every recolour call.
cases.outcome: Resolves the diff roles once before walking the elements and passes that same result to every recolour call.
cases.domain: any non-empty or empty element collection

cases.name: tokens-omitted
cases.condition: The optional tokens argument is omitted; role resolution and recolouring use the function's supported default token behavior.
cases.outcome: Uses the supported default token behavior for role resolution and recolouring.

cases.name: tokens-provided
cases.condition: Tokens are supplied; the same resolved diff roles derived from those tokens are used consistently for every element.
cases.outcome: Derives diff roles from the supplied tokens once and uses them consistently for every element.
cases.domain: any supported Tokens value

cases.name: geometry-preserved
cases.condition: Any element is processed; position and size, plus edge sections or annotation anchor where applicable, are carried through exactly unchanged.
cases.outcome: Preserves each element's position and size, along with edge sections and annotation anchors where applicable.
cases.domain: any element kind

cases.name: metadata-preserved
cases.condition: Any element is processed; id, parentGroup, layout, label, content, isSuperNode, and hiddenDescendantCount are carried through exactly unchanged where present.
cases.outcome: Preserves each element's id, parentGroup, layout, label, content, isSuperNode, and hiddenDescendantCount where present.
cases.domain: any element kind

cases.name: canvas-preserved
cases.condition: Any diagram is processed; laidOut.canvas is carried through untouched and is not recoloured.
cases.outcome: Carries the canvas through untouched without recolouring it.
cases.domain: any LaidOutDiagram

cases.name: input-not-mutated
cases.condition: Any diagram is processed; laidOut and its elements are not mutated, and the returned diagram is a restyled copy.
cases.outcome: Returns a restyled copy without mutating laidOut or any of its elements.
cases.domain: any LaidOutDiagram

cases.name: undefined-tokens
cases.condition: The tokens argument is undefined; the function immediately returns undefined without attempting resolution.
cases.outcome: Returns undefined immediately without attempting resolution.

cases.name: all-three-resolve
cases.condition: tokens is defined and all three references ($roles.diff_added, $roles.diff_modified, and $roles.diff_deleted) resolve. Each role may resolve directly to a literal value or through the supported one-hop palette reference, and the function returns DiffRoles containing the three resolved literal values.
cases.outcome: Resolves all three roles, including supported one-hop palette references, and returns a DiffRoles containing their literal values.
cases.domain: any defined tokens object whose three role references all resolve

cases.name: one-role-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and exactly one of the three role references cannot be resolved; the function returns undefined rather than filling the unresolved role.
cases.outcome: Returns undefined without filling the one unresolved role.
cases.domain: which one of the three role references is unresolved

cases.name: two-roles-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and exactly two of the three role references cannot be resolved; the function returns undefined.
cases.outcome: Returns undefined because two role references are unresolved.
cases.domain: which two of the three role references are unresolved

cases.name: all-three-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and all three role references cannot be resolved; the function returns undefined.
cases.outcome: Returns undefined because none of the three role references resolves.

cases.name: accepted-colored-input
cases.condition: A string accepted by rotateHue and representing a colored hexadecimal input is converted to an achromatic color with saturation set to zero while preserving its lightness, and the result is formatted as lowercase #rrggbb.
cases.outcome: Converts the accepted colored hexadecimal input to an achromatic color with zero saturation while preserving lightness and formats it as lowercase #rrggbb.
cases.domain: any accepted non-grey hexadecimal color string

cases.name: accepted-already-grey-input
cases.condition: An accepted already-grey hexadecimal input keeps all three channel values unchanged, while the returned string is normalized to lowercase #rrggbb.
cases.outcome: Keeps the accepted grey input's three channel values unchanged and normalizes the result to lowercase #rrggbb.
cases.domain: any accepted hexadecimal color whose red, green, and blue channels are equal

cases.name: accepted-uppercase-input
cases.condition: An accepted hexadecimal input containing uppercase letters is transformed normally and returned in lowercase #rrggbb form.
cases.outcome: Transforms the accepted uppercase hexadecimal input normally and returns the result in lowercase #rrggbb form.
cases.domain: any accepted hexadecimal color string with uppercase hexadecimal letters

cases.name: rejected-input
cases.condition: A string rejected by rotateHue is returned byte-identically without desaturation or case normalization.
cases.outcome: Returns any input rejected by rotateHue byte-identically without desaturation or case normalization.
cases.domain: any string rejected by rotateHue

cases.name: worked-blue-input
cases.condition: The specific input #8ad1ff produces #c4c4c4.
cases.outcome: Returns #c4c4c4 for the input #8ad1ff.

cases.name: worked-purple-input
cases.condition: The specific input #bb9af7 produces #c8c8c8.
cases.outcome: Returns #c8c8c8 for the input #bb9af7.

cases.name: worked-dark-blue-input
cases.condition: The specific input #122238 produces #252525.
cases.outcome: Returns #252525 for the input #122238.

cases.name: worked-uppercase-white-input
cases.condition: The already-grey input #FFFFFF keeps its channel values and produces the lowercase result #ffffff.
cases.outcome: Preserves the channel values of #FFFFFF and returns the lowercase result #ffffff.

cases.name: accepted-six-digit-hex
cases.condition: A string matching /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ is parsed as three sRGB channel pairs, converted to HSL, rotated by the degree amount modulo 360, converted back, and emitted as lowercase #rrggbb with channels rounded to the nearest integer.
cases.outcome: Parses the six-digit sRGB hex colour, rotates its HSL hue by degrees modulo 360 while preserving saturation and lightness, and returns rounded lowercase #rrggbb output.
cases.domain: any six-digit hexadecimal colour string with a leading #

cases.name: rejected-three-digit-hex
cases.condition: A three-digit hexadecimal string such as "#abc" is rejected and returned byte for byte unchanged, without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns a three-digit hex string unchanged byte for byte without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.domain: any three-digit hexadecimal colour string

cases.name: rejected-named-colour
cases.condition: A named colour such as "none" is rejected and returned byte for byte unchanged, without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns a named colour string unchanged byte for byte without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.domain: any named-colour string

cases.name: rejected-unresolved-token
cases.condition: An unresolved token such as "$roles.node_fill" is rejected and returned byte for byte unchanged, without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns an unresolved token unchanged byte for byte without parsing or lowercasing.
cases.domain: any unresolved colour-reference string

cases.name: rejected-empty-string
cases.condition: The empty string is rejected and returned unchanged, without an error.
cases.outcome: Returns the empty string unchanged without raising an error.

cases.name: accepted-uppercase-normalization
cases.condition: An accepted colour containing uppercase hexadecimal digits is parsed and always emitted in lowercase, even if the hue rotation leaves its colour unchanged; for example, "#8A8A8A" becomes "#8a8a8a" at 180 degrees.
cases.outcome: Parses the accepted colour and returns it in lowercase even when rotation leaves its colour unchanged.
cases.domain: accepted colours with one or more uppercase hexadecimal digits

cases.name: saturated-colour-hue-rotation
cases.condition: An accepted colour with nonzero saturation has its hue advanced by the supplied amount while saturation and lightness are kept, with the resulting channels rounded to integers.
cases.outcome: Rotates the hue of a nonzero-saturation colour by the supplied amount while preserving saturation and lightness, then rounds the resulting channels to integers.
cases.domain: accepted colours whose HSL saturation is greater than zero

cases.name: zero-saturation-identity
cases.condition: An accepted fully desaturated colour is unchanged in colour at every angle because it has no hue to advance, but its output is still normalized to lowercase.
cases.outcome: Returns a fully desaturated colour unchanged in colour at every angle, while normalizing accepted output to lowercase.
cases.domain: accepted colours whose HSL saturation is zero

cases.name: zero-degree-rotation
cases.condition: A finite degree value of zero leaves the colour unchanged apart from the required lowercase output normalization for accepted inputs.
cases.outcome: Returns an accepted colour unchanged apart from required lowercase normalization when degrees is zero.

cases.name: full-turn-rotation
cases.condition: A finite degree value equal to any whole number of full turns leaves the colour unchanged apart from lowercase normalization, because the hue is reduced modulo 360.
cases.outcome: Returns an accepted colour unchanged apart from lowercase normalization when degrees is any whole number of full turns.
cases.domain: any integer multiple of 360 degrees

cases.name: negative-degree-rotation
cases.condition: A negative finite degree value is reduced modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.outcome: Reduces a negative finite degree value modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.domain: any negative finite number

cases.name: over-360-degree-rotation
cases.condition: A finite degree value above 360 is reduced modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.outcome: Reduces a finite degree value above 360 modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.domain: any finite number greater than 360

cases.name: fractional-degree-rotation
cases.condition: A finite non-integer degree value rotates the hue by its fractional amount modulo 360, with the final RGB channels rounded to the nearest integer.
cases.outcome: Rotates the hue by a finite fractional degree amount modulo 360 and rounds the resulting RGB channels to the nearest integers.
cases.domain: any finite non-integer number

cases.name: empty-target-and-delta
cases.condition: An empty target graph and a delta with no node, edge, or group entries produce an empty overlay with matching empty change-type maps.
cases.outcome: It returns an empty overlay with empty nodes, edges, groups, and matching change-type maps.

cases.name: copy-target-elements-unchanged
cases.condition: Every node, edge, and group already present in target.graph is copied into the returned diagram and initially recorded as UNCHANGED; target is not mutated.
cases.outcome: It copies every target node, edge, and group into a new diagram and initially marks each UNCHANGED without mutating target.
cases.domain: any combination of target nodes, edges, and groups

cases.name: existing-key-non-deleted-delta
cases.condition: A node, edge, or group delta with change type ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED whose key exists in target records that change type while leaving the target element value untouched rather than applying after.
cases.outcome: It records ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED for an existing key while preserving the copied target element instead of applying after.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group; one of: ADDED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED

cases.name: missing-key-non-deleted-delta
cases.condition: A node, edge, or group delta with change type ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED whose key is absent from target is skipped: no element and no change type is added.
cases.outcome: It skips a non-deleted delta whose key is absent from target, adding neither an element nor a change-type entry.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group; one of: ADDED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED

cases.name: restore-deleted-element
cases.condition: A node, edge, or group delta with change type DELETED and a set before value restores that before value under its key and records DELETED.
cases.outcome: It restores a set before value under its key and records the element as DELETED.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: skip-deleted-without-before
cases.condition: A DELETED node, edge, or group delta whose before value is unset is skipped because there is nothing to draw.
cases.outcome: It skips a DELETED delta without before because there is no element to draw.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: skip-unspecified-change
cases.condition: A node, edge, or group delta with CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is skipped entirely, regardless of its after or before values.
cases.outcome: It skips a CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED delta regardless of its before or after values.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: drop-restored-edge-missing-source
cases.condition: A restored DELETED edge is omitted from the returned edges map and has no change-type entry when its own source field names a node key absent from the finished union nodes map.
cases.outcome: It omits a restored edge and its change type when its source is absent from the finished union nodes.
cases.domain: any restored edge with a missing source endpoint

cases.name: drop-restored-edge-missing-target
cases.condition: A restored DELETED edge is omitted from the returned edges map and has no change-type entry when its own target field names a node key absent from the finished union nodes map.
cases.outcome: It omits a restored edge and its change type when its target is absent from the finished union nodes.
cases.domain: any restored edge with a missing target endpoint

cases.name: drop-restored-edge-missing-both-endpoints
cases.condition: A restored DELETED edge is omitted from the returned edges map and has no change-type entry when both of its endpoint keys are absent from the finished union nodes map.
cases.outcome: It omits a restored edge and its change type when both endpoints are absent from the finished union nodes.

cases.name: keep-restored-edge-with-union-endpoints
cases.condition: A restored DELETED edge is retained and recorded as DELETED when both its source and target keys exist in the finished union nodes map, including when those nodes are themselves restored deleted nodes.
cases.outcome: It retains and marks DELETED a restored edge when both endpoints exist in the finished union, including restored nodes.
cases.domain: any restored edge whose two endpoint keys exist in the finished union

cases.name: clear-restored-node-parent
cases.condition: A restored DELETED node whose before.parentGroup names a group key absent from the finished union groups map is retained, recorded as DELETED, and has parentGroup unset as undefined rather than set to an empty string.
cases.outcome: It retains and marks DELETED a restored node but unsets parentGroup when its parent is absent from the finished union groups.
cases.domain: any restored node with a missing parent group

cases.name: clear-restored-group-parent
cases.condition: A restored DELETED group whose before.parentGroup names a group key absent from the finished union groups map is retained, recorded as DELETED, and has parentGroup unset as undefined rather than set to an empty string.
cases.outcome: It retains and marks DELETED a restored group but unsets parentGroup when its parent is absent from the finished union groups.
cases.domain: any restored group with a missing parent group

cases.name: keep-restored-element-with-union-parent
cases.condition: A restored DELETED node or group retains its before.parentGroup when that parent group key exists in the finished union groups map, including when the parent group is itself restored.
cases.outcome: It retains a restored node or group’s before.parentGroup when that parent exists in the finished union groups.
cases.domain: one of: node, group

cases.name: evaluate-references-after-all-deltas
cases.condition: Endpoint and parent-group cleanup is based on the finished union after every node, edge, and group delta has been applied, so entry ordering does not cause premature dropping or detachment.
cases.outcome: It performs endpoint and parent cleanup only against the finished union after all deltas are applied.
cases.domain: any combination of interdependent delta entries

cases.name: restore-edge-between-restored-nodes
cases.condition: A deleted edge between two deleted nodes survives when the edge and both endpoint nodes have set before values, because all three are present in the finished union.
cases.outcome: It retains and marks DELETED an edge between two deleted nodes when the edge and both nodes have set before values.

cases.name: restore-deleted-group-members-only-when-nodes-deleted
cases.condition: A deleted group's old membership is restored only for members that are themselves reported DELETED and therefore restore their before.parentGroup; nodes reported MODIFIED are not moved from their current target parent, and surviving members do not rejoin the deleted group.
cases.outcome: It restores a deleted group’s membership only through members reported DELETED, leaving MODIFIED or surviving nodes at their current target parents.
cases.domain: any deleted group with a mixture of deleted, modified, or surviving member nodes

cases.name: deleted-group-with-surviving-members-is-empty
cases.condition: A DELETED group is restored as an empty group when all nodes that used to belong to it survive in target rather than being reported DELETED.
cases.outcome: It restores a deleted group as an empty group when all former members survive in target.

cases.name: preserve-existing-dangling-target-edge
cases.condition: An edge already present in target is copied through as UNCHANGED; the restored-edge missing-endpoint rule applies to restored deleted edges and does not remove the existing target edge.
cases.outcome: It copies an existing target edge through as UNCHANGED even if an endpoint is missing, without applying restored-edge filtering.
cases.domain: any target edge whose endpoint is absent

cases.name: preserve-unrelated-map-entry-invariants
cases.condition: For every element retained in the returned nodes, edges, or groups map, the matching change-type map contains exactly one corresponding entry, and no change-type map contains a key absent from its element map.
cases.outcome: It ensures every retained element has exactly one matching change-type entry and every change-type key has a corresponding element.
cases.domain: any resulting overlay

cases.name: ignore-annotations
cases.condition: Annotations do not affect the merge because they are not part of Diagram.graph or the Delta node, edge, and group maps; no annotation data is copied or changed.
cases.outcome: It ignores annotations because they are outside Diagram.graph and the node, edge, and group delta maps.
cases.domain: any annotation content outside the content model

cases.name: non-deleted-change
cases.condition: The change is any value other than DELETED. The returned Glyph1D copy receives the applicable color transformations, while stroke.dashing is not changed by ghosting.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with applicable set colors transformed while leaving stroke.dashing unchanged.
cases.domain: any non-DELETED ChangeType

cases.name: deleted-with-stroke
cases.condition: The change is DELETED and the glyph has a stroke. The returned copy sets that stroke's dashing to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED, discarding its previous dashing; no other ghosting edit is made.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the existing stroke's dashing set to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED and makes no other ghosting edit.
cases.domain: any Glyph1D with a stroke

cases.name: deleted-without-stroke
cases.condition: The change is DELETED and the glyph has no stroke. No stroke is created, so no dashing value is added.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy without creating a stroke or adding a dashing value.

cases.name: stroke-color-case
cases.condition: The glyph has a stroke whose paint is the color case and whose color is set. The returned copy replaces stroke.color with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.outcome: Replaces the set color-case stroke.color with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.domain: any set stroke color

cases.name: stroke-color-unset
cases.condition: The glyph's stroke color is unset. It remains unset rather than being created or recolored.
cases.outcome: Leaves the unset stroke color unset.

cases.name: stroke-gradient-paint
cases.condition: The glyph's stroke paint is a gradient. The gradient is left unchanged rather than recolored.
cases.outcome: Leaves the gradient stroke paint unchanged.
cases.domain: any stroke gradient

cases.name: glow-color-set
cases.condition: The glyph carries a glow with a set color. The returned copy replaces glow.color with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.outcome: Replaces the set glow color with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.domain: any set glow color

cases.name: glow-color-unset
cases.condition: The glyph's glow color is unset. It remains unset rather than being created or recolored.
cases.outcome: Leaves the unset glow color unset.

cases.name: glow-gradient
cases.condition: The glyph's glow carries a gradient. The gradient is left unchanged rather than recolored.
cases.outcome: Leaves the glow gradient unchanged.
cases.domain: any glow gradient

cases.name: no-glow
cases.condition: The glyph has no glow. No glow is created and there is no glow color to recolor.
cases.outcome: Leaves the glyph without a glow and creates no glow color.

cases.name: preserve-style-properties
cases.condition: Regardless of change and color forms, the returned copy carries through stroke.width, stroke.cap, stroke.join, glow.radius, glow.intensity, and arrowheads entirely unchanged, including both arrowhead variants and their size.
cases.outcome: Carries stroke width, cap, join, glow radius, intensity, and both arrowhead variants and size through unchanged.
cases.domain: any values of the listed style properties

cases.name: input-not-mutated
cases.condition: The input glyph is not mutated; all recoloring and any deleted-change dashing update apply only to the returned copy.
cases.outcome: Applies all recoloring and any deleted-change dashing update only to the returned copy, without mutating the input glyph.
cases.domain: any Glyph1D

cases.name: color-fields-recolored
cases.condition: A glyph has stroke and/or fill using the COLOR paint case, plus any present glow or decoration colors; each present color is replaced with diffColorFor of its prior value and the glyph is returned as a copy without mutating the input.
cases.outcome: Returns a non-mutating copy with every present COLOR-case stroke, fill, glow, and decoration color replaced by diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.domain: any Glyph2D with one or more present color-bearing fields

cases.name: unset-colors-remain-unset
cases.condition: An optional stroke.color, fill.color, glow.color, or decoration color is absent; that field remains absent and no color is invented.
cases.outcome: Leaves every absent optional color absent without inventing a replacement.
cases.domain: any subset of the optional color fields

cases.name: gradient-paints-preserved
cases.condition: The stroke or fill uses the GRADIENT paint case; that paint and its gradient data remain exactly unchanged, and no color is derived from the gradient.
cases.outcome: Leaves GRADIENT stroke or fill paint and all gradient data exactly unchanged without deriving a color.
cases.domain: stroke or fill, independently

cases.name: decoration-colors-selective
cases.condition: A glyph has multiple decorations, including entries that set a color and entries that do not; only entries with a color are recolored, while all decoration metadata and unset colors are preserved.
cases.outcome: Recolors only decorations that have colors and preserves all decoration metadata and unset colors.
cases.domain: any number of decorations

cases.name: deleted-stroke-ghosting
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has a stroke; stroke.dashing is replaced with STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED regardless of its prior dashing, while the rest of the stroke is preserved.
cases.outcome: For a DELETED glyph with a stroke, replaces its dashing with STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED while preserving the rest of the stroke.
cases.domain: any stroke, including one with no prior dashing or a custom dash pattern

cases.name: deleted-without-stroke
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has no stroke; no stroke is created and no dashing is added.
cases.outcome: For a DELETED glyph without a stroke, creates no stroke and adds no dashing.

cases.name: deleted-fill-opacity-scaled
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has a fill; fill.opacity is replaced by its prior opacity multiplied by 0.4, treating an unset opacity as 1.0 and therefore producing 0.4.
cases.outcome: For a DELETED glyph with a fill, sets opacity to its prior value multiplied by 0.4, treating unset opacity as 1.0.
cases.domain: any present Fill with optional opacity

cases.name: deleted-without-fill
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has no fill; no fill is created and no opacity is added.
cases.outcome: For a DELETED glyph without a fill, creates no fill and adds no opacity.

cases.name: nondeleted-preserves-dashing-opacity
cases.condition: change is any type other than DELETED; existing stroke.dashing and fill.opacity values, including unset values, are left untouched and no ghosting edits are applied.
cases.outcome: For every non-DELETED change, preserves existing dashing and opacity, including unset values, without ghosting edits.
cases.domain: one of the non-DELETED ChangeType values

cases.name: shape-and-metadata-preserved
cases.condition: Regardless of paint cases and change type, shape_kind (including custom_path_ref), corner_radius, stroke dimensions and line styling, glow radius and intensity, and decoration identity, kind, text, icon, and position are carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Preserves shape, geometry, dimensions, line styling, glow properties, and all listed decoration identity and metadata while changing only specified colors, dashing, and opacity.
cases.domain: any Glyph2D

cases.name: both-colors-set
cases.condition: The Typography has both color and background set. Each current color is replaced with the result of diffColorFor using the supplied change and optional diffRoles; all other Typography fields are copied unchanged and the input is not mutated.
cases.outcome: Returns a non-mutating copy with both present colors replaced by diffColorFor using the change and optional diffRoles, while all other fields stay unchanged.
cases.domain: any Typography with both color and background present

cases.name: color-only
cases.condition: The Typography has color set and background unset. The color is replaced with diffColorFor, while background remains unset and all other fields are copied unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the present color replaced by diffColorFor, the background left unset, and all other fields unchanged.
cases.domain: any Typography with color present and background absent

cases.name: background-only
cases.condition: The Typography has background set and color unset. The background is replaced with diffColorFor, while color remains unset and all other fields are copied unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the present background replaced by diffColorFor, the color left unset, and all other fields unchanged.
cases.domain: any Typography with background present and color absent

cases.name: no-colors-set
cases.condition: Both optional colors are unset. No color conversion is performed; both remain unset and all other fields are copied unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with both colors unset and all other fields unchanged without performing color conversion.
cases.domain: any Typography with both color and background absent

cases.name: deleted-change
cases.condition: The change type is DELETED. Any present text colors are recolored in the same way as for other change types; the Typography receives no ghosting, including no special treatment of a deleted label.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, recolors each present text color normally without applying any ghosting or special deleted-label treatment.

cases.name: non-deleted-change
cases.condition: The change type is any non-DELETED change type. Any present colors are recolored with diffColorFor, with no ghosting, and all non-color Typography fields remain unchanged.
cases.outcome: For any non-DELETED change, recolors each present color with diffColorFor without ghosting and leaves all non-color fields unchanged.
cases.domain: any non-DELETED ChangeType

cases.name: diff-roles-omitted
cases.condition: The optional diffRoles argument is omitted. The function invokes diffColorFor without caller-supplied diff roles while preserving the Typography fields and optional-color presence rules.
cases.outcome: When diffRoles is omitted, calls diffColorFor without caller-supplied roles and preserves field values and optional-color presence.

cases.name: diff-roles-supplied
cases.condition: The optional diffRoles argument is supplied. It is used by the diffColorFor calls for present colors; no other Typography property is changed.
cases.outcome: When diffRoles is supplied, passes it to diffColorFor for each present color without changing any other Typography property.
cases.domain: any supplied DiffRoles value

cases.name: delta-omitted
cases.condition: The optional fifth parameter delta is undefined; the function uses the unchanged path, calling layoutPipeline with the original diagram and stylesheet and then rendering the layout result.
cases.outcome: With delta undefined, it calls layoutPipeline with the original diagram and stylesheet and renders the resulting layout unchanged.

cases.name: delta-defined-stylesheet-present
cases.condition: delta is defined and stylesheet is defined; the delta is merged into the diagram, component bindings are seeded from the merged diagram and the supplied stylesheet using the theme bound to 'default', layoutPipeline runs once on those seeded inputs, and the diff palette is applied before rendering.
cases.outcome: With delta defined and a stylesheet present, it merges the delta, seeds bindings from the merged diagram using the theme bound to default, lays out once, applies the diff palette, and renders.
cases.domain: any defined delta with a supplied stylesheet

cases.name: delta-defined-stylesheet-absent
cases.condition: delta is defined and stylesheet is undefined; the delta is merged, bindings are seeded from the merged diagram using a newly created empty schema-version-1 Stylesheet and the theme bound to 'default', layoutPipeline runs once on those inputs, and the diff palette is applied before rendering.
cases.outcome: With delta defined and no stylesheet, it merges the delta, seeds bindings using a new empty schema-version-1 stylesheet and the theme bound to default, lays out once, applies the diff palette, and renders.
cases.domain: any defined delta with no stylesheet

cases.name: layout-error
cases.condition: layoutPipeline returns Err; renderPipeline returns that same PipelineError, preserving its stage, and does not invoke the renderer.
cases.outcome: If layoutPipeline returns Err, it returns the same PipelineError with its stage preserved and does not invoke the renderer.
cases.domain: any input combination for which layoutPipeline fails

cases.name: render-error
cases.condition: layoutPipeline succeeds but SvgRendererImpl().render returns Err; renderPipeline returns an Err with stage 'render' and the render failure message as its detail.
cases.outcome: If layout succeeds but rendering returns Err, it returns an Err with stage render and the render failure message as its detail.
cases.domain: any input combination for which layout succeeds and rendering fails
